author: Bobby Grayson
description: The pattern 'a state predicate closed under beh, lifted to every reachable configuration because the behaviour never spawns' is reusable and lives in Leanactors/Examples/Ringlog.lean as Ok / ok_step / beh_no_spawn / AllOk / allOk_step / allOk_reach. If a second example wants it, hoisting allOk_step into SysProps as a generic 'Sys.AllOk' over an arbitrary predicate would be the place; it was left local this round because one instance does not justify the abstraction.
title: No generic Lean lemmas were added to SysProps/Fair/AssocList by this piece: the ringlog proof is built only from existing SysProps lemmas (SysStep.stateOf_spawn_cases, Effect.init?) plus example-local ones (Ok/ok_step/beh_no_spawn/AllOk). Siblings have nothing to reuse or clash with from wf6/structs
